record.one_liner: Command-line interface and Node.js API for Mermaid to generate SVG/PNG/PDF files from mermaid definitions.

auth_methods.quote: This is a command-line interface (CLI) for mermaid . It takes a mermaid definition file as input and generates an SVG/PNG/PDF file as output.

api_type.quote: It's possible to call mermaid-cli via a Node.JS API. Please be aware that the NodeJS API is not covered by semver

official_mcp.quote: This is a command-line interface (CLI) for mermaid .

auth_methods.reason: The pages show it is a command-line interface tool taking input definition files and generating graphics without authentication requirements.

access_test.reason: Developers can install the package via npm for free to test it.

access_ship.reason: The CLI and Node.js API can be freely installed and used via npm or Docker without commercial restrictions.

api_type.reason: The documentation explicitly describes calling mermaid-cli via a Node.JS API.

api_breadth.reason: The Node.JS API example shows a narrow function call using `run` to convert an input file to an output file.

official_mcp.reason: The documentation shows it is a command-line interface for mermaid and does not mention any Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.
